kaaba.name: The Kaaba (the House)
kaaba.dict: The House at Mecca: "the first house established for mankind" (3:96), whose foundations Abraham and Ishmael raised (2:127), and which Abraham was told to purify for those who circle it, stand, bow and prostrate (22:26). It is the goal of the pilgrimage (3:97) and the direction of prayer (2:144). It is called the Kaaba twice (5:95, 5:97), and otherwise the House, the Sacred House, or the Ancient House.
